info.title: Ridal HTTP API
info.description: Schemas of the JSON bodies the Ridal server returns. Routes are not described here yet; see the HTTP API reference page for them.

Added.description: `POST /api/v1/datasets`: the radargram is in the project.

bytes.description: The size of the file as stored.

archived_interpretations.description:
How many interpretations sit in the archive under this id, from an
earlier removal. Almost always zero. When it is not, the operator has
just reused an id that someone drew picks on, and only they know
whether this is the same line coming back or a different one taking
its name.

AnchorAxis.description: An anchor axis: a named, invariant quantity plus the mapping from index to it (SPEC §7.4.2). The mapping's fields (SPEC §7.5) sit alongside `name`, `unit` and `synthetic`; which of them are present depends on `type`.

synthetic.description:
`true` when the producer fabricated these values rather than the
instrument recording them (SPEC §8.4).

Assignment.description: Which profile a radargram uses, and the steps of its own that run first.

Axis.description:
One axis: the units the geometry is stored in, plus any anchor mappings
(SPEC §7.4).

anchor.description: Anchor mappings, in the producer's preference order.

fallback.description:
The pre-0.1 name for `anchor`, accepted on read (SPEC §7.4) and
re-emitted only if it was present, so an old document round-trips
unchanged rather than being silently rewritten.

version.description: The profile version the batch processes with.

seen_at.description:
When whoever started it dismissed its report, so it is no longer
announced to them.

Bundle.description:
The files of one raw recording, as they were read.

`coordinates` is the file the positions were actually read from: a
`--cor` override when one was given, otherwise the recording's own.

format.description: The format's name, as `ridal formats` lists it (`ramac`, ...).

BundleFile.description: One file of a recording, by role and content.

CarriedView.description:
`GET …/interpretations/{user}/carried`: the picks as they would be drawn
on the current revision, and what carrying them there did.

oneOf.description:
The gprinterp document as it should be drawn, or `null` when it
cannot be carried (`report.severity` is `refused`).

CarryReport.description:
Every field is sent, `null` when it does not apply, so a client reads one
shape whatever happened.

from_revision.description: The revision the document says it was drawn on, where it says.

x_anchor.description: Which anchor axis each side was carried through, when it was.

kept.description: How many features were placed on the new revision.

oneOf.description:
How far the placed features moved. `null` when nothing was carried,
or when any feature was dropped.

refusal.description:
Why it could not be carried. Set exactly when the severity is
`refused`.

headline.description:
One sentence for the banner, written for whoever is looking at the
radargram rather than for a log.

warnings.description:
Reasons to check the carried picks against the data that the axes
cannot see, such as one revision being migrated and the other not
(#370). Empty when there are none.

ConsequenceReport.description: Everything a replace would do, before it does any of it.

revision_id_collision.description:
`true` when the incoming file fingerprints to the revision id the
outgoing one already has. The replace is then refused.

For a file with a recipe (#382) this means it was made from the
same raw files in the same way, so there is nothing to replace.
Without one, `RevisionId` is `hash(radargram_id +
processing_datetime)` and says nothing about contents, so a file
edited in another tool can carry the same datetime and produce the
same id. Every cache and staleness check would then believe nothing
changed, which is why it has to be reported rather than assumed
away.

oneOf.description: `null` when either revision has no `time` axis to count traces by.

outgoing_axes_kept.description:
Whether the outgoing revision's mapping could be kept. Without it
no document drawn on it can ever be shown again (SPEC §8.1 forbids
falling back to the raw index), so a replace that cannot snapshot
is refused at commit.

worst.description:
The worst tier across every document, or `current` when there are
none. What the dialog leads with.

Convention.description: Indexing conventions (SPEC §7.3). The permitted values are fixed, and a validating reader rejects anything else.

grants.description:
The projects the token may act in. Each grant's role and download
scope may not exceed the account's membership there.

DatasetAxes.description:
`GET /api/v1/datasets/{radargram_id}/axes`: a radargram's axes, read from
the file's variables of the same names. An axis the file lacks is `null`.

distance.description: Along-track distance per trace, in metres.

twtt.description: Two-way travel time per sample, in nanoseconds.

elevation.description: Surface elevation per trace, in metres, as the file stores it.

entries.description: The radargrams the caller may see, in catalog order.

warnings.description:
Problems found while cataloguing, such as a file that could not be
read, limited to those about radargrams the caller may see.

DatasetSummary.description:
One radargram as the catalog lists it: an entry of `GET /api/v1/datasets`,
and the whole of `GET /api/v1/datasets/{radargram_id}`.

relative_path.description: The file's path, relative to the directory it was found under.

processing_datetime.description:
The processing datetime exactly as the file stores it (RFC 3339).
The revision id is derived from it together with the radargram id.

processing_datetime_display.description: The same instant as `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM`, for display only.

revision_id.description:
Identifies this processing of the radargram (#117). A local file
with the same radargram id and revision id is the same revision.

shape.description: `[samples, traces]`: the rows and columns of the file's `data`.

track_length_m.description:
The track's total length in metres (#319), summed over its segments.
`null` when the file has no readable track.

in_project.description:
Whether this radargram sits in the project rather than in an external
root (#147). Only one in the project can be removed.

unlisted.description:
Left out of listings by a project override (#145). Unlisted entries
are listed only for `operator` and above.

line_count.description:
Picked lines stored for this radargram, across every user. `null`
when the server is not serving a project, and in
`GET /api/v1/datasets/{radargram_id}`, which does not count them.

contributor_count.description:
How many users have at least one picked line here (#272). `null`
exactly when `line_count` is.

Dem.description: A DEM uploaded once for the project.

at.description: When the file was uploaded, RFC 3339.

radargram_ids.description: The radargrams linked to it, sorted.

DemView.description: A DEM, as the list and the single view give it.

Displacement.description:
How far the carried coordinates moved, in index units.

Traces and samples rather than metres or nanoseconds, because that is
what the viewer draws in and what "did this pick move" means on screen.
The median says whether the revisions broadly agree; the worst says
whether any single vertex went somewhere else, which an average would
hide behind a thousand that did not.

key.description: Uniquely identifies the target radargram within the producer's scope.

features.description:
Always stored canonically as an array (SPEC §4.1), even when the
input used the permitted FeatureCollection form (SPEC §5.2).

allOf.description:
The carry that *would* be shown after the replace. Not applied —
nothing is written to the document either now or at commit.

DocumentConsequence.description: What replacing this radargram would do to one interpretation.

DownloadScope.description: What someone may download from a project, least first. Each scope includes the ones before it: `none` allows nothing, `results` the consensus results, `picks` adds every contributor's raw picks, `derived` adds level 2 points and rendered images, and `all` adds the radargram files and tracks.

DraftView.description: A draft as the API gives it.

Dropped.description: A feature that could not be placed on the new revision.

ErrorBody.description: The body of every API error: `{"error": {"code", "message"}}`.

code.description:
Stable and machine-readable, such as `dataset_not_found`. A client
branches on this rather than on `message`.

message.description: For a person to read. The wording may change between releases.

FileRole.description: What a file is to the recording it belongs to.

oneOf.description: Any other geometry, kept as it is.

Geometry.description: A GeoJSON geometry (SPEC §4.3). A geometry of a type not listed here is kept verbatim rather than rejected.

revision_id.description:
The revision the axes describe. A document carrying them should name
it in `source.revision_id`.

oneOf.description:
The `coordinates.axes` block for a gprinterp document (its SPEC
§7.4), or `null` when the file cannot describe its axes.

Grant.description: What a token may do in one project, at most.

role.description:
The highest role the token acts with here. The account's membership
still applies, so the token never has more than the account.

download.description: The widest download scope the token has here, under the same rule.

name.description: The file name, for people reading the recipe. Not hashed.

blake3.description: blake3 of the file's bytes, as 64 hex characters.

status.description: Always `"ok"`: a server that can answer is up.

version.description:
The Ridal version the server runs, such as `0.7.1`. Health needs no
login, so a client can check what it is talking to before signing in.

users.description:
Everyone with a stored interpretation of this radargram, by account
name. Listing them needs no download scope; reading one may.

writable.description: Whether the caller may save picks here, which takes the `picker` role.

writing.description: Every step has run and the file is being written.

JobStatusView.description:
[`JobStatus`] without what is the server's business: where its files
are, and the key it was queued under.

user.description:
The signed-in account, or `null` for an anonymous caller. With an API
token, the token's account.

server_admin.description:
Whether the caller administers the site. Always `false` with an API
token, which never carries server administration.

authentication_configured.description:
Whether the site has accounts at all. Without them there is nothing
to sign in to, and every caller is anonymous.

oneOf.description: The API token the request came with, or `null` for a session.

NewToken.description: `POST /api/v1/tokens`: the token, shown this once, and its record.

token.description:
The whole token, `ridal_<id>_<secret>`. It is not stored and cannot
be shown again; send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

picks_not_carried.description:
Whose picks did not come across whole: moved enough to matter,
partly left out, or not carried at all. Empty when every
interpretation carried, or there were none.

oneOf.description: Processed to exactly what is served already.
The server stopped before it finished.

Outcome.description: How one item of a batch ended, or where it is.

PicksNotCarried.description:
One person's picks that a committed item did not carry whole, from the
replacement's consequence report.

dropped.description: How many of their features were left out.

Position.description: A GeoJSON position: `[x, y]` in index space (SPEC §7.1), trace index then sample index. Further elements are kept.

oneOf.description: Processed as the profile says now, from the raw data its source names.
Processed some other way than the profile and source say now.

profile_version.description: The profile version it was processed with, when it matches one.

custom.description:
Processed with steps or a velocity that match no version of the
profile: changed for this radargram, as opposed to left behind
by the profile. False for a file that records no recipe, which
cannot say.

oneOf.description:
Processed as the profile says, but by an older version of a step or
of the rest of Ridal (#383). Not stale: the same request gives a
different file only because Ridal has changed since.
Raw data and a profile, but nothing processed yet.

No raw data in the project, so nothing can be reprocessed. Never
counted as stale (#382).

ProcessingState.description: Where a radargram stands against its processing profile.

versions.description: Oldest first; the last is current. Never empty.

version.description: From 1, one more for every change to the steps or the velocity.

steps.description:
Canonical, with every argument written out, as a recipe records
them; so a changed default is not a silent change to the profile.

current_version.description: The version radargrams are processed with now.

ProfileView.description: A profile, as the list and the single view give it.

ProjectEntry.description:
One project as the caller sees it: an entry of `GET /api/v1/projects`,
and the whole of `GET /api/v1/projects/{key}`.

key.description:
What the project is addressed by, in `/api/v1/projects/{key}/…`.
`ridal gui` serves its one project as `default`.

name.description: The display name, or the key when the project has none.

description_long_html.description:
The long description rendered from Markdown to HTML, with raw HTML
in the source escaped. `null` when there is none.

created_by.description:
The account that created the project, if it was created through the
site rather than on the command line.

member.description:
Whether the caller is a member, or a server administrator, who is
treated as one.

radargram_count.description:
How many radargrams the last scan found, or `null` if the project
has never been scanned.

role.description:
The caller's role here. A non-member gets `viewer`, and a server
administrator `admin`.

require_auth_to_read.description: Whether reading the project needs a login.

projects.description: The projects the caller may see, in key order.

Promoted.description:
`POST …/interpretations/{user}/promote`: the carried view is now the
interpretation.

from_revision.description: The revision the picks were drawn on, where the document said.

to_revision.description: The revision they are now drawn on.

dropped.description: Features that did not fit on the new revision and were left out.

archived.description:
Where the interpretation as it was drawn was kept, or `null` when
nothing needed keeping.

RadargramStatus.description: One radargram in a profile, and where it stands.

RawSource.description: What one radargram is made from.

bundles.description: The raw recordings, in the order they are merged.

crs.description: The CRS to project positions into; the project's default otherwise.

oneOf.description: The project's DEM to take elevations from.

RevisionDeclarations.description:
A processed file's identity and axis declarations: everything a
replace's consequence report reads from the incoming file (#331).

The body of `POST /api/v1/datasets/{radargram_id}/replace/preflight`,
and what `ridal._ridal._preflight_body` reads from a local file for the
Python client (#328), so one type is both ends of the request. A type of
its own rather than [`AxisDeclarations`] itself, so the API does not
change when that internal type does.

radargram_id.description: The file's radargram id. It must be the radargram in the path.

processing_datetime.description:
The file's `ridal_processing_datetime` attribute, verbatim. With the
radargram id it gives the revision id of a file without a recipe.

recipe_hash.description:
The file's `ridal_recipe_hash` attribute (#382), or `null` when it
has none. When present, it and the radargram id give the revision
id instead of the datetime.

time.description:
The file's `time` variable: acquisition time per trace, in seconds
since the Unix epoch.

twtt_anchor.description:
The `anchor_name` attribute of the file's `twtt` variable, or `null`
when it has none.

twtt_crop.description:
The file's `twtt_crop` variable: one value, one per trace, or empty
when the file has none.

twtt_time_zero.description: The file's `twtt_time_zero` variable, in the same way.

dt_ns.description:
The spacing of the file's `twtt` variable in nanoseconds (its second
value minus its first), or 0 when it has fewer than two.

n_samples.description: The length of the file's `twtt` variable.

antenna_separation_effective_m.description:
The file's `antenna_separation_effective` attribute, in metres:
zero once the radargram was corrected for the separation.

logged_resolution_m.description:
The depth grid spacing in metres that the file's `processing_log`
records for `correct_antenna_separation`, when it records one.

Role.description: What someone may do in a project, weakest first. Each role includes the ones before it: a `picker` writes their own picks, an `operator` also curates and replaces radargrams, and an `admin` also manages members and access.

version.description:
The new version, also sent as the `ETag`. Send it as `If-Match` with
the next save.

warnings.description:
What the gprinterp validator noticed but did not refuse, such as a
feature without a stable id.

Severity.description: How much the carried view can be trusted, worst first when reported.

ShapeChange.description: How the two revisions' grids compare.

SignedIn.description:
The response to signing in, by password (`POST /api/v1/auth/login`) or
by redeeming an invite (`POST /api/v1/auth/invite`). The session itself
is the `ridal_session` cookie set alongside it.

signed_out.description:
Always `true`. Signing out clears the cookie whether or not there
was a session.

id.description: The conceptual radargram; stable across reprocessing.

revision_id.description: The specific processed revision; changes on every reprocess.

SourceDem.description:
A source's link to one of the project's [`Dem`]s: which, and its file
when the link was made. A DEM's file cannot change while anything links
to it, so the two agree.

radargram_ids.description:
Sorted. Served or not: raw data uploaded for a radargram that has
not been processed yet is listed too.

recordings.description:
What each recording's header and positions say, in merge order.
Only `PUT` reads the recordings; `GET` leaves this empty.

Staged.description:
`POST /api/v1/datasets/{radargram_id}/replace`: the file is staged, and
this is what committing it would do.

token.description:
Commits or discards the staged file, in
`/api/v1/datasets/{radargram_id}/replace/{token}`. Swept after 6 hours.

bytes.description: The size of the staged file.

StoredFile.description: `POST /api/v1/raw`: the file was stored, or was already.

x.description: Value in the anchor axis' unit.

TokenInfo.description: A stored API token, without its secret or its hash.

account.description: The account the token acts as.

grants.description: The projects the token may act in, and its ceiling in each.

expires.description: RFC 3339, or `null` for a token that never expires.

TokenSummary.description: An API token as its holder may see it: never its secret (#194).

id.description: Names the token in lists and the audit log, and revokes it.

grants.description:
The projects the token may act in, and its ceiling in each. In each,
the account's own membership also applies.

expires.description: RFC 3339, or `null` for a token that never expires.
